name: Recording
tagline: No spec and no plugin? Record the provider's sandbox through Stuntman and it writes the plugin for you.
stands_in_for: Any HTTP provider with a sandbox
point: the sandbox's host on :8443, Test CA trusted

capabilities.title: Record through the sandbox
capabilities.text: Each call goes to the upstream and back; the app gets the real answer and Stuntman keeps the pair.

capabilities.title: Secrets never kept
capabilities.text: Auth headers, keys and password fields become secret://; e-mails, card numbers and CPFs become synthetic ones.

capabilities.title: Every call or only new
capabilities.text: mode=unknown sends only calls no route answers, to finish a plugin that is almost done.

capabilities.title: Stops by itself
capabilities.text: After stop_after (default 30 min) or max calls (default 500). Pause and resume at any time.

capabilities.title: Review before writing
capabilities.text: Calls grouped into routes like /v2/shipments/{id}, one answer per status, the most frequent success as default.

capabilities.title: Ids and dates as templates
capabilities.text: Changing ids become random_id(), dates now(), and values the app sent are echoed back.

capabilities.title: Rules suggested
capabilities.text: A field only the error calls lacked becomes a rule: when !body.destination.postal_code, answer invalid.

capabilities.title: Binary answers as files
capabilities.text: A PDF label or an image up to 5 MB is kept next to the plugin and sent as it came.

callouts.title: Record the real provider
callouts.text: One of the ways to start a service, next to a spec or the catalog.

callouts.title: The upstream
callouts.text: The provider's sandbox: Stuntman sends each call there and keeps a copy.

callouts.title: Every call or only unknown
callouts.text: Record from zero, or let the routes answer and send only the rest.

callouts.title: Never kept
callouts.text: Credentials go to secret://; card numbers, CPFs and e-mails are replaced with synthetic ones.

callouts.title: Sandbox keys only
callouts.text: The key reaches the provider as the app sent it and may use its quota.

callouts.title: Time left
callouts.text: The recording stops by itself; Stop and review ends it now.

callouts.title: Calls kept, secrets masked
callouts.text: Pause sends nothing more to the sandbox; calls then get the routes' answers or 404.

callouts.title: A PDF kept as a file
callouts.text: Binary answers up to 5 MB are saved next to the plugin.

callouts.title: No answer from the sandbox
callouts.text: A timeout gives the app a 502 and is left out of the review.

callouts.title: What was kept
callouts.text: authorization stored as secret://globex-token, never the real value.

callouts.title: Routes found
callouts.text: Uncheck what the plugin should not have, such as a health check.

callouts.title: How paths were grouped
callouts.text: Ids in paths became {id}; split them back if they are different routes.

callouts.title: Create the plugin
callouts.text: Writes routes and answers; Record more adds to the same recording.

callouts.title: Default answer as a template
callouts.text: Ids and dates became templates; fields equal to the request echo it.

callouts.title: Rule suggested
callouts.text: Tells the invalid answer apart from created by the field its calls lacked.

provoke.name: A recorded error
provoke.what: The provider's own 422 or 404, on the next calls

provoke.name: Answers no rule reaches
provoke.what: A recorded answer kept without a rule, given only on demand

provoke.name: The timeout the sandbox gave
provoke.what: The upstream that never answered, now on cue

provoke.name: Network and server failures
provoke.what: Reset, empty reply, 500, 503 or an HTML page

provoke.name: Slow provider
provoke.what: Latency on every answer of the recorded service

provoke.name: No route
provoke.what: While paused or after the limit, unknown calls get 404 no route

advantages.title: Sandbox needed once
advantages.text: After make_plugin the provider is no longer called; tests run offline and in CI.

advantages.title: Real shapes, no secrets
advantages.text: Answers are the provider's own, with credentials and personal data masked before saving.

advantages.title: Failures the sandbox hides
advantages.text: The recorded plugin takes force_answer, latency and expired tokens like any other.

advantages.title: A plugin you can read
advantages.text: Routes, answers and rules in plain YAML, edited in the route editor.

agent.prompt: Record the shipping sandbox while our integration tests run, then turn it into a plugin.
steps: recording; point the app at http://localhost:8028/globex-shipping
tools: Sends the service's calls to the sandbox and keeps each pair
State, calls kept, time left; review=true shows the review
Writes the plugin from the review
Gives any recorded answer on the next calls

notes: HTTP only: no WebSockets or server-sent events. One recording per service; the provider has 30 s to answer.
State is not inferred: add keep and lookup by hand when a read must return what was created.
